agents.name: editor-in-chief
agents.description: Owns the whole production: story vision, phase sequencing, approvals, and arbitration between departments.

agents.name: comic-writer
agents.description: Writes the comic script: page breakdowns, panel descriptions, dialogue, captions, and sound effects.

agents.name: script-editor
agents.description: Gives structural coverage on scripts and adaptations; guards source fidelity, causality, and dialogue economy.

agents.name: art-director
agents.description: Owns the visual language (line, tone, color, texture) and reviews all imagery against the style bible.

agents.name: character-designer
agents.description: Builds and maintains character identity: face, silhouette, wardrobe states, and reference sheets.

agents.name: environment-designer
agents.description: Designs locations and props, and maps every space so staging and continuity can reason about it.

agents.name: layout-artist
agents.description: Breaks the story into pages and panels: grids, panel sizes, reading flow, page turns, and thumbnails.

agents.name: penciller
agents.description: Composes each panel (framing, angle, staging, acting) so one drawable moment reads at a glance.

agents.name: colorist
agents.description: Sets the color strategy: palette, color scripts, spot color, and tone continuity across pages.

agents.name: letterer
agents.description: Places balloons, captions, and sound effects; owns reading order, exact text, and lettering checks.

agents.name: continuity-editor
agents.description: Tracks position, custody, wardrobe, and physical state panel by panel; owns ledgers and continuity state.

agents.name: prompt-director
agents.description: Builds reference plans and compiles page data plus approved masters into provider-ready prompt packages; never freehands a prompt.

agents.name: image-generation-specialist
agents.description: Runs page and reference generation through image providers, saves versioned candidates, and records provenance.

agents.name: visual-reviewer
agents.description: Inspects rendered pages against the plan and references; records evidence-based findings and verdicts.

agents.name: prepress-specialist
agents.description: Assembles editions and exports PDF, CBZ, web, and social deliverables to spec.

agents.name: production-qa
agents.description: Runs the validation gates: schema compliance, roster integrity, provenance, approval, and cost policy.
